arguments.argument: LAUNCHER_JAR=$(basename $(ls ${product.dir}/win32/win32/x86_64/plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar)) INSTALL_DIR="C:/Program Files/${app.name}" jpackage \ --type exe \ --name ${app.name} \ --app-version ${parsedVersion.majorVersion}.${parsedVersion.minorVersion}.${parsedVersion.incrementalVersion} \ --input ${product.dir}/win32/win32/x86_64 \ --main-jar plugins/$LAUNCHER_JAR \ --main-class org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main \ --dest ${project.build.directory}/installer/windows \ --win-dir-chooser \ --win-menu \ --win-shortcut \ --arguments -clearPersistedState \ --arguments -nl \ --arguments de \ --java-options -Dosgi.instance.area=@user.home/.taskman \ --java-options -Declipse.product=com.vogella.tasks.ui.product \ --java-options "-Dosgi.configuration.area=@user.home/.taskman/configuration" \ --java-options "-Dosgi.sharedConfiguration.area=$INSTALL_DIR/app/configuration"

LAUNCHER_JAR=$(basename $(ls ${product.dir}/linux/gtk/x86_64/plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar)) jpackage \ --type deb \ --name ${app.name} \ --app-version ${parsedVersion.majorVersion}.${parsedVersion.minorVersion}.${parsedVersion.incrementalVersion} \ --input ${product.dir}/linux/gtk/x86_64 \ --main-jar plugins/$LAUNCHER_JAR \ --main-class org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main \ --dest ${project.build.directory}/installer/linux \ --linux-shortcut \ --arguments -clearPersistedState \ --arguments -nl \ --arguments de \ --java-options -Dosgi.instance.area=@user.home/.taskman \ --java-options -Declipse.product=com.vogella.tasks.ui.product \ --java-options -Dosgi.configuration.area=@user.home/.taskman/configuration \ --java-options -Dosgi.sharedConfiguration.area=/opt/taskman/lib/app/configuration \ --icon ${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/taskman.png

if ! command -v rpmbuild &> /dev/null; then echo "rpmbuild not found, skipping rpm package generation" exit 0 fi LAUNCHER_JAR=$(basename $(ls ${product.dir}/linux/gtk/x86_64/plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar)) jpackage \ --type rpm \ --name ${app.name} \ --app-version ${parsedVersion.majorVersion}.${parsedVersion.minorVersion}.${parsedVersion.incrementalVersion} \ --input ${product.dir}/linux/gtk/x86_64 \ --main-jar plugins/$LAUNCHER_JAR \ --main-class org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main \ --dest ${project.build.directory}/installer/linux \ --linux-shortcut \ --arguments -clearPersistedState \ --arguments -nl \ --arguments de \ --java-options -Dosgi.instance.area=@user.home/.taskman \ --java-options -Declipse.product=com.vogella.tasks.ui.product \ --java-options -Dosgi.configuration.area=@user.home/.taskman/configuration \ --java-options -Dosgi.sharedConfiguration.area=/opt/taskman/lib/app/configuration \ --icon ${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/taskman.png

LAUNCHER_JAR=$(basename $(ls ${product.dir}/macosx/cocoa/x86_64/plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar)) jpackage \ --type dmg \ --name ${app.name} \ --app-version ${parsedVersion.majorVersion}.${parsedVersion.minorVersion}.${parsedVersion.incrementalVersion} \ --input ${product.dir}/macosx/cocoa/x86_64 \ --main-jar plugins/$LAUNCHER_JAR \ --main-class org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.Main \ --dest ${project.build.directory}/installer/macos \ --arguments -clearPersistedState \ --arguments -nl \ --arguments de \ --java-options -XstartOnFirstThread \ --java-options -Dosgi.instance.area=@user.home/.taskman \ --java-options -Declipse.product=com.vogella.tasks.ui.product \ --java-options -Dosgi.configuration.area=@user.home/.taskman/configuration \ --java-options "-Dosgi.sharedConfiguration.area=/Applications/${app.name}.app/Contents/app/configuration" \ --icon ${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/taskman.png
